name: better-profiles
description: grouping extensions and activating them only when needed

commands.title: Give A Group To A Profile…

betterProfiles.storageFile.markdownDescription: Advanced. Path to VS Code's `storage.json`, where profiles and their workspace associations are recorded. Leave empty to use the one next to this extension's global storage.

betterProfiles.groupsFile.markdownDescription: Where your extension groups are kept. Leave empty to use `groups.json` in this extension's global storage, which every profile shares. Point it into a dotfiles repository to version it.

betterProfiles.codeCommand.markdownDescription: Advanced. An executable to run instead of this VS Code's own command line (for example a custom build). Used to list and install extensions per profile. Leave empty to use the built-in one.

betterProfiles.codeArgs.markdownDescription: Advanced. Arguments that always come first when `#betterProfiles.codeCommand#` runs, for example `--user-data-dir` and `--extensions-dir` for a portable or non-default installation.

enumDescriptions: Never check whether a profile has the extensions of its groups.
Shortly after startup, ask before installing what the current profile is missing.
Install what the current profile is missing without asking. Nothing is ever uninstalled automatically.
betterProfiles.autoSync.markdownDescription: Whether the current profile is brought up to date with its extension groups. Uninstalling is never automatic: it only happens through `Better Profiles: Sync Profile With Its Groups…`, which lists what would go and asks first.

betterProfiles.keepExtensions.markdownDescription: Extension ids (`publisher.name`) that are never offered for uninstalling, even when no group mentions them.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
